components.name: Chart/Box plot
components.description: Five-number summary per group — minimum, quartiles, median, maximum — with outliers as hollow dots. Violin shows the density shape; Box + points adds every value behind the box. 3–12 groups; groups as rows so labels stay readable on mobile. React: <BoxPlot data={[{ group, values }]} variant="box | violin | points" />

Chart/Box plot
Five-number summary of a numeric value per group, with outliers; Violin shows the density shape, Box + points every value behind the box. 3 variants.

When to use
Compare the spread, not just the average, of 3–12 groups (order value by city, response time by team).
Spot skew and outliers before choosing a mean or a median for a KPI.
Violin when the shape matters (two peaks); Box + points when n < 50 per group so readers see the sample.

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Groups as rows — labels stay horizontal and readable on mobile.
Sort groups by median unless the order is meaningful (time, size).
Whiskers = 1.5 × IQR (Tukey); state it in the tooltip or footnote.
One colour for all groups; colour only to highlight one group.
Median, not mean
The line inside the box is the median. If the business KPI is a mean, add it as a Data point marker and say so in the legend.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
